- ASHRAYA Search products and services Careers Home Careers JOINING DHANLAXMI BANK FAMILY Dhanlaxmi Bank is a 98 year old organization renowned for its rich culture and heritage. Established in 1927 at Thrissur for promoting a social cause, the Bank was a Kerala based entity in the initial decades. It became a Scheduled Commercial Bank in 1977 and progressively branched out into the rest of India. The Bank's has 549 customer Outlets (including 264 Branches, 285 ATMs) across 14 States and 1 Union Territory. The Bank has seamlessly integrated tradition with technology for attracting customers across generations. Over the years, it has established a good track record for meeting customer needs with care, courtesy and concern. The vision of the Bank "Banking on Relationships forever" appropriately mirrors this priority. Caution Notice It has come to our attention that some fraudsters have hosted websites which contains fake job openings appear to be as of it from Dhanlaxmi Bank. It is clarified that Dhanlaxmi Bank never publishes job openings in any third party web sites. All details regarding the job openings would be published only on www.dhan.bank.in/careers Benefits and Rewards A friendly but challenging work environment awaits you. Even as you keep contributing to the achievement of the Bank's corporate goals, there will be adequate scope for self-development along the way. All in all, working for the Bank will truly be an experience to cherish. BROWSE OUR JOB ENTRIES Time line for applying to the positions of Officers is over. However, please continue to search for other job opportunities in Dhanlaxmi Bank Website.
